figures.claim: Conventional teaching gives the normal step off as around 10 millimetres at 90 degrees of flexion.
The restraint is greatest at 90 degrees and the corner contributes more at 30.
External rotation at 30 degrees separates an isolated cruciate injury from a combined corner injury, which is the distinction that changes the operation.
